boundary: This proves Bockstein isolation and uniqueness of the realized fixed-scalar tower. It does not compute the complete integral cohomology ring or assert that the abstract scalar Schur class vanishes in every coefficient system.

cohomology.decomposition: End(V)=F2*I direct-sum sl(V), because trace(I)=81=1 mod 2
cohomology.short_exact_sequence: 0 -> End(V) --times2--> End(V) over Z/4 -> End(V) over F2 -> 0

compatible_tower.source: the same exact integral {-1,0,1} generator matrices and exact relation words
compatible_tower.uniqueness: H1=0 at every square-zero fixed-scalar step

theorem: The only mod-two degree-two class is scalar. The deformation Bockstein has zero image because H1(G,End V)=0, while H2(G,sl V)=0 eliminates every traceless obstruction. The exact integral W33 matrices provide a compatible lift through every 2-power, so the realized obstruction is zero and the fixed-scalar lift is unique up to strict equivalence. The ambient scalar Schur-multiplier line is therefore isolated from the actual representation-deformation tower.
